verdict.rationale: Elicit has a documented feature to invite team members to collaborate live in Research Agent sessions, with edit-access collaborators able to ask the agent questions, produce new artifacts, and edit others' work, plus reports/tables can be exported as PDF/Word/CSV for sharing. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of the live collaboration feature working smoothly, and no detail on view-only/read-access sharing permissions.
